name: Acquirer Protocol Parameters 18
definition: Acceptor parameters dedicated to the acquirer protocol.

ActionType.name: Action Type
ActionType.definition: Type of action for the configuration parameters.

AcquirerIdentification.name: Acquirer Identification
AcquirerIdentification.definition: Identification of the acquirer using this protocol.

Version.name: Version
Version.definition: Version of the acquirer protocol parameters.

ApplicationIdentification.name: Application Identification
ApplicationIdentification.definition: Identification of the payment application, user of the acquirer protocol.

OnLineTransaction.name: On Line Transaction
OnLineTransaction.definition: Acquirer protocol parameters of transactions performing an online authorisation.

OffLineTransaction.name: Off Line Transaction
OffLineTransaction.definition: Acquirer protocol parameters of transactions performing an offline authorisation.

ReconciliationByAcquirer.name: Reconciliation By Acquirer
ReconciliationByAcquirer.definition: Indicates the reconciliation period is assigned by the acquirer instead of the acceptor.| Usage: When absent, default value is False.

TotalsPerCurrency.name: Totals Per Currency
TotalsPerCurrency.definition: Indicates the reconciliation total amounts are computed per currency.| Usage: When absent, default value is False.

SplitTotals.name: Split Totals
SplitTotals.definition: Indicates that totals in reconciliation or batch must be split.| Usage: When absent, default value is False.

SplitTotalCriteria.name: Split Total Criteria
SplitTotalCriteria.definition: List of criterion to use when totals in reconciliation or batch must be split.

CompletionAdviceMandated.name: Completion Advice Mandated
CompletionAdviceMandated.definition: To notify that the acquirer expect to receive a completion advice after each update of reservation.|The default value is True.

AmountQualifierForReservation.name: Amount Qualifier For Reservation
AmountQualifierForReservation.definition: Identification of available amount qualifier for a reservation.

ReconciliationError.name: Reconciliation Error
ReconciliationError.definition: After an error in a totals of the Reconciliation, the POI sends transactions in error in the BatchTransfer messages.|The default value is False.

CardDataVerification.name: Card Data Verification
CardDataVerification.definition: Indicates whether the POI must send card data (protected or plain card data) in the AcceptorCompletionAdvice message following an authorisation exchange.|The default value is False.

NotifyOffLineCancellation.name: Notify Off Line Cancellation
NotifyOffLineCancellation.definition: Send a cancellation advice for offline transactions not yet captured.|The default value is False.

BatchTransferContent.name: Batch Transfer Content
BatchTransferContent.definition: Types of transaction to include in the batch.

FileTransferBatch.name: File Transfer Batch
FileTransferBatch.definition: BatchTransfer are exchanged per file transfer protocol rather than per message.|The default value is False.

BatchDigitalSignature.name: Batch Digital Signature
BatchDigitalSignature.definition: BatchTransfer are authenticated by digital signature rather than a MAC (Message Authentication Code).|The default value is False.

ProtectCardData.name: Protect Card Data
ProtectCardData.definition: Indicator to require protection of sensitive card data in messages.| Usage: When absent, default value is  True.

PrivateCardData.name: Private Card Data
PrivateCardData.definition: Indicator to require a private protection of sensitive card data in messages.| Usage: When absent, default value is False.

MandatorySecurityTrailer.name: Mandatory Security Trailer
MandatorySecurityTrailer.definition: A security trailer is mandatory in the messages.| Usage: When absent, default value is  True.
